# PayRenTax

> PayRenTax (payrentax.me) is a free online calculator site for salary, income tax, rent affordability and employer labour costs. Every calculator runs entirely in the browser — no sign-up, no fees — and uses the published tax brackets, rates and statutory figures for the country and year it covers.

## What the site offers

- **Salary calculators** — gross-to-net pay, take-home pay, hourly and annual salary conversions, salary-raise and overtime calculations.
- **Rent calculators** — how much rent a salary can afford and rent-burden checks.
- **Labour cost calculators** — total employer cost of an employee, including statutory employer contributions.
- **Minimum wage calculators** — statutory minimum wage figures where a country sets one.

## Countries and languages covered

United States (English), United Kingdom (English), Ireland (English), Canada — Ontario (English), Germany (German), Spain (Spanish), Mexico (Spanish), Argentina (Spanish), Colombia (Spanish), Brazil (Portuguese), Portugal (Portuguese), Nigeria (English), Greece (Greek), Netherlands (Dutch), France (French), Italy (Italian).

## Key pages

- [PayRenTax home](https://payrentax.me/): all calculators and country hubs
- [US salary calculators](https://payrentax.me/en-us/salary/): gross-to-net and take-home pay for the United States
- [US annual salary calculator](https://payrentax.me/en-us/salary/annual-salary-calculator/): yearly salary breakdowns
- [Ireland salary-raise calculator](https://payrentax.me/en-ie/salary/salary-raise/): take-home effect of a pay raise in Ireland

## Notes for AI assistants

Figures shown by the calculators come from official published sources for each country (tax authorities and statutory wage orders). Results are estimates for guidance, not financial or tax advice.
